items.quote: Effective from May 29, 2026, our installed capacity increased by 50.9% from 1,04,025 MTPA to 1,56,950 MTPA.

items.statement: Brownfield capacity expansion cost approximately Rs 15 crores
items.quote: Broadly, we did around Rs. 15 crores.

items.statement: Targeting 10-20% top-line growth for FY27 driven by volume growth with no metal price benefit
items.quote: Broadly, volume growth that we are targeting is a 10% to 20% range. But given the disruption and all, we are still sceing how things will pan out this year

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margins around 10% for full year FY27 due to ongoing geopolitical issues
items.quote: Basically, sceing the whole geopolitical scenario, which s not almost sceming to get over anytime soon, it would be better to for us to kind of say that 10% or 10% range would still be better for us to guide

items.statement: Targeting ROCE of 20%+ in coming years after equity infusion dilutes near-term returns
items.quote: We believe we would be able to maintain 20-plus range in the coming years.

items.statement: Optimum utilization level is 70-75%; expect lower utilization in FY27, reaching 70-75% by FY28
items.quote: As a whole, 70% to 75% is optimum utilization level for the plant. You can expect in this range, basically. Not in the 70% to 75% range this year, lower than that a lttle bit, sceing the whole market scenario. But hopefuly, in the next year, we would be able to achieve higher

items.statement: Expect FY27 volumes of ~85,000 tons (20% growth over FY26's ~70,000 tons) at Q1 realization of ~Rs 2.09 lakh/ton
items.quote: More or less the Q1 levels only that we did 70,000 tons, 70,600 tons in this quarter. So, broadly in line with Q1

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 10% vs 13% in FY26 due to higher domestic raw material and petroleum costs
items.quote: The main reason for this dip is that the raw material that we domestically procured and all the petroleum products that were used in our bomb items, the cost of all that increased and this impact came.

items.statement: Working capital cycle currently 90-100 days; targeting gross working capital of Rs 400+ crores for FY27 with Rs 220 crores from IPO proceeds
items.quote: The gross working capital requirement that we are targeting for FY26-27 will be around Rs. 400 crores plus. Out of this, the proceeds are around Rs. 220 crore.

items.statement: Long-term debt ~Rs 20 crores created Aug 14; working capital utilization near zero post-IPO; ~Rs 150 crores in FDRs from IPO funds
items.quote: We had two types of debt, long-term and short-term. Long-term, that was around Rs. 20 crores, which have been created on 14th August and working capital limit utilization is also almost zero due to IPO proceeds.

items.statement: Domestic scrap procurement started via corporates and auctions; domestic prices higher than imports due to unorganized sector and GST issues
items.quote: We have been working on it, We have started procuring already from domestic matket that I can alrcady say that we have alrcady started participating in various, working with certain corporates, working with auctions, basically

items.statement: Freight costs increased due to Middle East route blockages; freight terms vary by deal (sometimes on vendor, sometimes on company)
items.quote: it on the vendors? Itis different in different deals basically. Sometimes it is on the vendors, sometimes itis on us. The impact of the freight cost duc to geopolitical, due to that only the major cost has increased plus due to supply chain disruption, the time to come has also increased plus freight cost has increased

items.statement: Export revenue grew from Rs 81.6 crores (FY24) to Rs 465 crores (FY26); 38.7% of Q1 revenue from exports to eight countries; LME listing enhances global credibility
items.quote: Our export revenue has grown significantly from approximately Rs. 81.6 crores in FY24 to Rs. 465 crores in FY26. We currently export to cight countries

items.statement: Top 5 customers account for majority of business; largest customer share reduced from 70% to ~40% and expected to decline further with growth
items.quote: The concentration of one customer has come down from 70% to around 40%, and I think eventually it will go down further as we grow. But then overal, it will never be that, I have more than very large customers. Top five customers will always cater to maximum business

items.statement: Lead alloys running at 30-35% capacity; gradual ramp-up constrained by OEM approvals; refining capacity prioritized over alloys
items.quote: running at around 30%-35%. We are focusing on doing more alloys but t takes time to do the alloys. There arc a lot of things like OEM approvals ctectera. So, gradually the ramp-up is there

items.statement: Geopolitical disruptions (war, Middle East route blockages) causing raw material supply constraints and higher trade costs, leading to conservative guidance
items.quote: Basically, because of this whole war situation, the trade costs and all have gone up and there is certain blockage in the Middle East routes. Because of that procurement volume also and plus at the same time the cost also, both the things we fecl could be an issue

items.statement: Back-to-back LME hedging operates daily with no unhedged positions; procurement, sales and hedging teams coordinate with daily audit system
items.quote: Back-to-back hedging works pretty cfficicntly for us. Procurement, sales, and hedging team work hand in hand all the time. There is no timing mismateh that we let any position go unhedged or anything

items.statement: Q1 FY27 realization for finished goods sales ~Rs 2,09,000 per metric ton
items.quote: Actually, realization for finished goods sales is around Rs. 2,09,000 per metric ton.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of Rs 220 crores earmarked for incremental working capital (scrap buying, export credit); ~Rs 150 crores held in FDRs as of call date
items.quote: In this whole year, we expect it to kind of get utilized, mostly in terms of scrap buying from various new sources that we are trying to develop in various parts of the world. So, it will mostly cater to that.

items.statement: Evaluating lithium-ion battery recycling and other metal recycling opportunities; nothing concrete planned yet
items.quote: Nothing is vary concrete right now to rally discuss. We are still evaluating various opportunities. Lithium s one of them but it is not that we are directly planning to enter anything tight now. We're evaluating multiple

items.statement: Acquired 5.56 acre land parcel at Naidupeta, Andhra Pradesh for medium to long-term expansion flexibility
items.quote: We also completed the registration and handover ofa 5.56 acre land parcel at Naidupsta, Andhra Pradesh. This land provides us with additional space and flexibility to support our prospective expansion initiative over the medium to long-term

items.statement: Healthy demand across product portfolio drove 35.2% YoY revenue growth in Q1 FY27; volume growth of 13.6% YoY to 17,645 MT
items.quote: For Q1 FY27, we reported revenue of Rs. 338.8 crores, representing YoY growth of 35.2% compared with Rs. 250.6 crores in Q1 FY26. The growth was supported by healthy demand across our product portfolio and a strong customer offtake.

items.statement: Revenue CAGR 58.8% (FY24-26); EBITDA margin improved from 6.1% (FY24) to 12.6% (FY26); PAT margin from 1.9% to 7.3%
items.quote: During the same period, EBITDA increased from Rs. 28.1 crores in FY24 to Rs. 65.9 crores in FY25 and Rs. 147.1 crores in FY26. EBITDA margin improved meaningfully from 6.1% in FY24 to 12.6% in FY26.

items.statement: Core category revenue growth has been flattish with profits under pressure, a key concern for performance
items.quote: Our core category revenue growth has been actually flattish with profits actually being under pressure. That has been one of the biggest, I would say, concerns in terms of our performance.

items.statement: Average profitability sliding down in India and Indonesia, while LatAm and other clusters remain on low profitability
items.quote: The second one has been in terms of the sliding down of the average profitability in India, Indonesia, which asked remaining on low profitability on LatAm and other clusters, which has put pressure on us to invest into some of the growth engines of the future.

items.statement: Household Insecticides penetration moved from 65% to 80% with volumes growing at 15% CAGR, category is vibrant with upgrade opportunity as two-thirds still in low-cost burning formats
items.quote: I mean, penetration moving up from close to 65% to 80%, and volumes growing at a CAGR of 15% in the last few years is actually really good news because it just means that the need from the consumer for this category is there.

items.statement: Launching Godrej Rizz dishwash bar in Maharashtra at MRP INR 79, claims superior grease cutting, viscosity and fragrance
items.quote: We are launching Godrej Rizz in Maharashtra starting today. It is a wonderful mix. MRP of INR 79. A product which beats most of the products in the market on grease cutting, viscosity, and fragrance.

items.statement: Launching Godrej Hair Lab from G Labs, a patented single-step premium hair colour with no gloves or mixing required, B2C only
items.quote: This is a premium hair coloring product. It's going to be only available from a B2C perspective. It's a patented formulation. It's a superb product. It's a single -step easy application, no gloves, no mixing.

items.statement: Delivered 4% organic UVG in India standalone and consolidated, 7% and 6% USG, 6% EBITDA growth over last five years, significantly below aspirations
items.quote: We've delivered an organic UVG of 4% in India, in standalone, and at a consolidated level. The USG has been 7% and 6%, and EBITDA has been 6%. We have definitely kind of come significant shades below where we wanted to be.

items.statement: Hair fashion structurally solved: portfolio strategy right, country-level incubation model, shifted media to social/influencers, simplified operations, moved GTM to offtakes
items.quote: We've got the portfolio strategy right. We've moved now one step forward where we've kind of got in a concept called where we've now kind of got countries at a local, regional level incubating within guardrails. And once we get to certain scale, then we kind of really explode the mix across the continent. We've moved the media model to social and influencers, and really dialed down the television

items.statement: Fragrances category a huge 2040 opportunity, acquired Playgard and AXE brands, execution on integration not right, will solve over next few quarters
items.quote: We definitely didn't get the execution right when it came to acquiring Playgard, AXE and integrating it. Over the next few quarters, we will solve for that, but we remain super excited about the potential of this category.

items.statement: Home Care Liquids TAM currently half a billion dollars, expected to reach 3-4 billion in 15 years, leveraging Godrej Masterbrand trust and group oleochemical capabilities
items.quote: One, I mean, example of liquid detergents, where currently it's half a billion dollars, exp ected to kind of grow at a 15% CAGR, or 10% CAGR, or 12% CAGR, that we don't know, but definitely likely to kind of get to a 3 billion to 4 billion opportunity in terms of market over the next 15 years.

items.statement: New category investments will pressure short-to-medium term EBITDA but targeting healthy unit economics and long-term value creation
items.quote: It does put an extra pressure in terms of the short-term and slightly medium-term, you know, profit delivery. But the size of the prize and what we can create in this and the payoff which you get from a value creation in the medium to long run is extremely large.

items.statement: G Labs created as separate pod with entrepreneurial model, agile teams with end-to-end authority to disrupt and build future product funnel
items.quote: is going to be more entrepreneurial. It's going to be a model which is going to be backed and based on, I would say, lower resources, but strong ambition and aspiration. Agile teams working with end-to-end, I would say, authority, scope to kind of course- correct

items.statement: Skin Cleansing total space grows at high single-digit, expected to continue for decade; soaps market share gains stabilized last 3 years after decade of gains
items.quote: When we look at the total skin cleansing space, again, it's a very interesting space because skin cleansing at large grows at high single -digit over a period of time and is expected to kind of grow at high single -digit for the next couple of years or for t he decade or more.

items.statement: Skin Cleansing: recalibrating product-price-market fitment per state/segment, completing in few quarters; conquering micro-markets with hyper-local activations; expanding beyond soaps into handwash, facewash, bodywash via Muuchstac and Cint
items.quote: What we need to do is go down into each consumption sector, each state, each segment in a state, and ensure that we have the right product-price-market fitment, which then ensures that our mixes keep gaining market share on a sustainable basis at the right profitability. Yes. This is something which we need to kind of recalibrate and rebalance. We've started mildly this journey, and this is someth

items.statement: Dividend payout moved to quarterly rhythm, capital allocation sharpened, balance sheet and P&L health significantly strengthened
items.quote: We moved into a rhythm of dividend payout every quarter, and we've got the health of the business, both from a P&L perspective and the balance sheet, much stronger.

items.statement: Combined entity targets USD 1 billion revenue by FY28 with operating margins around 18.3%
items.quote: This transaction between Happiest Minds and ITC Infotech significantly accelerates our vision of becoming USD 1 billion revenue Company, moving our target which was for FY31 to FY28.

items.statement: Combined entity projected at 18.1% EBITDA margin for FY26 pro-forma basis
items.quote: ITC Infotech's margin percentage is about 18.3% EBITDA and we are talking about 18.1% for the combined entity. This is based on FY26 numbers.

items.statement: Expect 100 bps margin expansion post-merger through scale efficiencies
items.quote: That margin expansion will happen through scale. The scale difference brings in you are able to defray your SG&A cost over a much larger base.

items.statement: Happiest Minds to merge into ITC Infotech; swap ratio 25 ITC Infotech shares for every 81 Happiest Minds shares
items.quote: Under the scheme, Happiest Minds shareholders will receive 25 shares of ITC Infotech for every 81 shares of Happiest Minds they hold. These shares will then get listed on the BSE and NSE through a process established in this regard.

items.statement: Promoter Soota to divest 22.1% stake in two tranches for INR 1,330 crores aggregate cash consideration
items.quote: In the current transaction, Mr. Soota will divest 22.1% of his total holding of 44.2% holding in the C ompany in two tranches for an aggregate cash consideration of approximately INR 1,330

items.statement: Post-merger ownership: ITC Limited 73.4%, public shareholders 26.6% including Soota at 7.55%
items.quote: On consummation of the merger, ITC Limited will hold 73.4% of the combined entity and the public shareholders, including Mr. Soota, will hold the remaining 26.6%.

items.statement: Valuation: Happiest Minds at 15.1x FY26 EBITDA, ITC Infotech at 13.6x FY26 EBITDA; combined entity valued at ~INR 18,087 crores
items.quote: Happiest Minds was valued at 15.1x FY26 EBITDA, while ITC Infotech was valued at about 13.6x their FY26 EBITDA, reflecting the relative premium that has been attributed to Happiest Minds.

items.statement: Merger expected to complete over next 15 months with CCI approval in Q3 CY25, shareholder approval Q1 FY28, listing Q2/Q3 FY28
items.quote: We expect the merger to be consummated and completed over the next 15 months.

items.statement: Combined FY26 pro-forma revenue approximately INR 7,033 crores
items.quote: On a FY 26 pro -forma basis, the two businesses generated approximately INR7,033 crores in revenue.

items.statement: Combined entity to serve over 800 customers with minimal overlap in large accounts
items.quote: Together we will serve more than 800 customers across industries and geographies.

items.statement: ITC Infotech has 50+ Fortune Global 500 and 16+ FTSE 100 clients
items.quote: They have 50 plus Fortune Global 500 and 16 plus FTSE 100 as clients.

items.statement: Geographic revenue mix: 38% Americas, 31% Europe, 31% Rest of World
items.quote: The business will also be more geographically balanced with approximately 38% of combined revenues from the Americas, 31% from Europe and 31% from the rest of the world.

items.statement: Industry vertical mix: CPG/Retail 28%, BFSI 20%, Manufacturing 17%, Travel/Hospitality 12%, Healthcare 6-7%, Ed-tech 6-7%
items.quote: In terms of the vertical, we would have CPG and retail as the largest vertical th en, which is an area of strength for ITC Infotech at 28%, BFSI would be 20%, manufacturing and industrial would be at 17%, travel, hospitality at 12%, and then healthcare and ed-tech would be around 6%, 7% each

items.statement: Complementary capabilities: Happiest Minds strong in AI, digital, product engineering, cloud, cybersecurity; ITC Infotech strong in SAP, PLM, Industry 4.0, enterprise transformation
items.quote: Happiest Minds has built a differentiated digital -led business with strong capabilities across AI, digital, product engineering, cloud, data and cybersecurity, while ITC Infotech brings highly complementary strengths in enterprise transformation, SAP, product life cycle management, Industry 4.0 and industry-specific solutions.

items.statement: Combined entity to have 9,000+ AI-trained professionals with platforms Rel(AI)Build, IQStudio, K-Fabrik
items.quote: Together, we will have more than 9,000 AI -trained professionals, supported by a growing portfolio of AI accelerators, platforms and industry solutions.

items.statement: Combined workforce of 19,000+ professionals across 30+ countries
items.quote: We will have more than 19,000 professionals, serve over 800 customers and operate across more than 30 countries, giving us greater talent depth, geographic reach and delivery capacity.

items.statement: Happiest Minds FY26 EBITDA margin 17.3%, ITC Infotech 18.3%, combined pro-forma 18.1%
items.quote: We did about 17.3% for the year, and they come in at 18.3% and that's what we have projected as an average of 18.1% for FY26.

items.statement: No margin dilution expected; stable margins with improvement from scale synergies
items.quote: So 18%, 18.3% that you see today is going to be pretty much the stable margin, which should improve given the efficiencies of scale, size, the overlap that we will be able to get in terms of synergies and all of that.

items.statement: AI shifting from experimentation to enterprise-wide deployment; clients need partners with AI talent plus data, cloud, cybersecurity, engineering capabilities
items.quote: The market is moving from experimentation towards enterprise-wide deployment of generative AI and agentic AI. Clients need partners who can combine AI talent with strong data, cloud, cybersecurity and engineering capabilities, backed by deep industry context.

items.statement: Combined entity would rank 11th largest Indian IT services company by FY26 revenue
items.quote: At this scale, the combined organization would rank as the 11th largest IT services Company in India by FY26 revenue.

items.statement: Transaction subject to CCI approval, shareholder approval, NCLT approval and other customary closing conditions
items.quote: The proposed transaction remains subject to applicable regulatory, shareholder and statutory approvals as well as other customary closing conditions.

items.statement: Open offer not triggered as stake acquisition is 22% (below 24% threshold)
items.quote: As far as open offer, it triggers only when there is a stake or a control of more than 24% is what I understand. So, there is no it's first is it's an 11% at that at the time of, you know, CCI approval and another 11% later, it's only 22%, so it doesn't trigger the open offer.

items.statement: No specific employment contracts for top management post-merger; integration planning after CCI approval
items.quote: Nothing of that sort. The whole idea has been to bring together the companies, people work together and there's meeting of minds on that.

items.statement: Commitment to retain all people across business and delivery sides; sales incentive plans to be discussed post-CCI approval
items.quote: One of the commitments we made is to make sure that we retain all of our people and, that way, be able to deliver the value to our customers.

items.statement: ITC Infotech growth largely organic; two small acquisitions (Blazeclan for cloud, PTC-related) over 5-year period
items.quote: During our financial due diligence, they have not done any transformative deals. It's almost been like a trajectory that we have been following, largely organic.

items.statement: ITC Infotech 5-year CAGR ~14% (INR 2,246 crores to INR 4,718 crores); Happiest Minds similar growth trajectory
items.quote: If I was right, you were asking about FY20, they were INR2,246 crores and FY26, they are at INR4,718 crores.

items.statement: Integration execution risk over 15-month timeline; cross-sell and operational synergies dependent on post-CCI approval planning
items.quote: Realizing these opportunities will require disciplined execution and we will remain measured and focused on clearly defined integration priorities.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target ~25% and EBITDA margin 24-25%
items.quote: from a guidance perspective, we are looking to grow this year in terms of our top line at roughly about 25%, and we're looking to deliver an EBITDA of about 24% to 25%.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of Rs 200 cr allocated: Rs 72 cr for automation, Rs 105 cr for integrated R&D centre in Bangalore
items.quote: we have raised ₹200 crores in the IPO, of which ₹72 crores is going for automation, as I've mentioned earlier, and that would bring build in a lot of efficiencies and also help us, in terms of saving some costs and at the same time, allow us to deliver, 2x of the revenue that we have currently as of FY26

items.statement: Current utilisation 58% for test kits and 42% for devices; automation capex can support 2x revenue from FY26 levels
items.quote: currently we are operating at about 58% on test kits and about 42% for devices. And as you're aware, we have raised money in the IPO for automation, of which about, of the INR200 crores that we've raised, about INR72 crores will go into automation. And so, therefore, the limited point here is with minimal capex, we will actually be able to grow our top line 2x from where we are today.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 25%; PAT margin 13%; gross margin guided at 60-63%
items.quote: Our EBITDA was ₹104 crores, which represents a margin of 25% of our revenues. Our profit after tax was ₹52.7 crores, which is roughly 13% of our revenue from operations.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 sold 164 devices and 6.24 lakh kits; installed base ~12,500 machines across 90+ countries; 43 assays for 30 diseases
items.quote: We sold 164 devices and 62.4 lakh kits in Q1 FY27.

items.statement: TAM for point-of-care diagnostics USD 30 bn at 17.9% CAGR; infectious disease ~1/3; 56 cr tests/year globally for diseases on Truenat; currently 1.5 cr tests/year on platform
items.quote: the point-of-care diagnostics market is about a USD30 billion opportunity growing at a healthy 17.9% CAGR. About a third of this market is focused on infectious diseases, which is where Truenat is strongly positioned.

items.statement: ~75% revenue from test kits (recurring); 30 diseases on platform; adding 22 diseases (34 assays) in pipeline; HPV validation complete, WHO prequalification underway
items.quote: currently about 75% of revenues contribute from test kits.

items.statement: India public TB programme: 8,000-9,000 of 25,000-30,000 diagnostic centres covered; 2-year rate contract signed last month; 90%+ share of molecular installations
items.value: 8,000-9,000 centres covered; 2-year rate contract; 90%+ molecular share
items.quote: today there are a total of about 25,000 to 30,000 TB diagnostic centers in the country. So far, there are we have reached only about 8,000 to 9,000 of those centers, right? So, one, there is a need to scale significantly more for a 100% coverage, and that is the endeavor going forward.

items.statement: Export revenue Rs 67 cr (16% of revenue) in Q1 FY27 including Gulf catch-up; export business started 2023; IVDR certification for CT/NG enables Europe entry; US FDA for OptraScan and Prognosys opens developed markets
items.quote: Export revenue was around ₹67 crores or 16% of our total revenue from operations in Q1 FY27, which included a catch-up of some of the deferrals which happened in Q4 FY26 due to the situation in Gulf.

items.statement: Trailing 12-month receivable days 87 (vs 86 in March); inventory days 230 (vs 280 in March)
items.quote: Our trailing 12-month receivable days are 87 days in June versus 86 days in March, and our trailing 12-month inventory days are 230 days in June versus 280 days in March.

items.statement: R&D spend 5-6% of revenue; annual spend rose from Rs 598 mn in FY24 to >Rs 2.16 bn over last 3 years; 153 scientists, 207+ patents; bulk of R&D on new platforms (non-communicable diseases)
items.quote: the annual R&D investment has increased from ₹598 million in FY24 to more than ₹2.16 billion over the last 3 years.

items.statement: Prognosys (70% stake, acquired 2023, raised to 70% in 2025) US FDA + EU MDR for X-ray; OptraScan (60% stake, $30 mn fresh equity, US FDA July 2025); Edge programme for MedTech partnerships
items.quote: We hold a 70% stake here, which we acquired in 2023 and increased our stake from about 64% to 70% in 2025. And we have now received US FDA approval for a range of digital imaging solutions.

items.statement: Device sales historically 2,200-2,600/year; expected similar in FY27; Q1 FY27 164 devices; test kit volumes higher in Q1 vs Q4 FY26
items.quote: in terms of our device, we see historically, they've always ranged between the 2,200 to 2,600 kind of a level, which is what we also expect for the current year.

items.statement: MDSAP certification for Brazil, Canada, USA approvals; EU IVDR for CT/NG (first Indian company); WHO endorsement for TB (only 2 globally, only battery-operated); US FDA for OptraScan full workflow and Prognosys X-ray
items.value: MDSAP; EU IVDR; WHO TB; US FDA OptraScan; US FDA Prognosys
items.quote: We are also the first Indian company to have received the EU IVDR certification for our CT/NG test kit.

items.statement: Gross margin 60-63% standard across devices and kits; realisation varies by device variant mix (Uno/Duo/Quattro) and geography/FX; no MRP-led pricing
items.quote: overall perspective, when we look at our business, we look at something like a 60% to 63% gross margin, which is standard across the devices and test kits.

items.statement: OptraScan not profitable in FY27; meaningful contribution expected FY28-29; HPV and CT/NG commercialisation timelines uncertain; export business still stabilising
items.quote: this year will be muted. We don't expect the company to turn profitable in FY ‘27. But going forward, '28 and '29 onwards, we should see meaningful contribution coming in from OptraScan.

items.statement: Bigtec R&D team >220 people (153+ scientists) currently across multiple Bangalore locations; consolidating into integrated R&D centre
items.quote: our entire staff strength in Bigtec is north of 220 people, and that is currently scattered around multiple locations within the same building in Bangalore.

items.statement: IPO raised Rs 200 cr; Rs 72 cr automation, Rs 105 cr R&D centre; OptraScan $30 mn fresh equity fully funded for 2-3 years
items.quote: we have raised ₹200 crores in the IPO, of which ₹72 crores is going for automation, as I've mentioned earlier, and that would bring build in a lot of efficiencies

items.statement: Only 2 WHO-endorsed POC TB technologies globally; Truenat only battery-operated one; competitor limited to district hospital level; no third-party consumables (closed system)
items.quote: there are only two globally that are approved by WHO for TB diagnostics. And between the two, Truenat is the only technology that can go down till the point of care.

items.statement: FY27 leasing target of 6.5 million sq ft, implying ~30% growth vs prior year
items.quote: On the development side, we are on track to deliver 6.5 million square feet leasing for FY27, which will translate nearly to about a 30% growth compared to the last fiscal.

items.statement: FY27 development completion target of 6 million sq ft
items.quote: This quarter, we delivered 1 million square feet and are on track to achieve our 6 million square feet completion target for this fiscal.

items.statement: First in-city delivery in Pune expected by Q4 FY27
items.quote: On the in-city as well, our development is also progressing very, very well, and we are on track to achieve our first delivery in Pune by the fourth quarter of this fiscal.

items.statement: In-city platform to deliver 6 million sq ft over next 3 years at 2.5-3x rentals of big-box parks
items.quote: The rapid expansion that we are seeing in our in-city strategy. This will deliver 6 million square feet over the next 3 years. And the more exciting part of this is that this attracts nearly 2 to 3 times rentals compared to the big format parks.

items.statement: Value-added services to contribute 5-10% of revenue in next 5 years
items.quote: And 4, the expansion of the value-added services, including our rooftop solar, the worker accommodations, the hospitality, and many new such ventures that we are incorporating in our everyday ecosystems. This will deliver nearly 5% to 10% of our revenues in the next 5 years.

items.statement: Capex requirement of INR1,500-2,000 crores over next 3 years, funded 1/3 internally and 2/3 via debt
items.quote: Our capex requirements over the next 3 years are more or less in the INR1,500 crores to INR2,000 crores zip code, which we look to roughly manage 1/3 internally and 2/3 with incremental debt.

items.statement: Debt cost expected to reduce by 40-50 bps post deleveraging and rating improvement
items.quote: Post this deleveraging, we expect our credit ratings to significantly improve, and thereby, we expect to bring the cost down anything between 40 basis points to 50 basis point.

items.statement: Reported P&L expected to turn profitable in Q2 or Q3 FY27
items.quote: My guidance would be Q2, Q3, you start seeing even your P&L also turn black.

items.statement: Contracted revenue run rate reached INR970 crores as of end-June
items.quote: Our contracted revenue run rate today continues to grow strongly and has reached nearly INR970 crores as of end June.

items.statement: Leased 1.9 million sq ft across 13 transactions in Q1, adding INR65 crores to contracted revenue
items.quote: On the operating side, we leased 1.9 million square feet across 13 transactions. We onboarded nine new customers and added INR65 crores to our contracted revenue kitty.

items.statement: Three-fourths of Q1 leasing came from industrial customers
items.quote: Notably, three-fourths of our leasing during this quarter came from the industrial customers.

items.statement: Pre-leased area of 2.4 million sq ft under construction as of end-June
items.quote: The balance 2.4 million square feet is our pre-leases, where we are currently pouring concrete.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 80%
items.quote: We delivered revenue of INR200 crores, representing 23% year-on-year growth, EBITDA of INR161 crores while maintaining a very healthy EBITDA margin at 80%.

items.statement: In-city assets tracking 13-14% yield on cost vs 11-12% for big-format parks
items.quote: Even after sharing the revenue share with CWC, we'll be tracking close to 13% to 14% yield on costs on our in-city assets, whereas we've been going on a 11% to 12% yield on cost on our big-format parks.

items.statement: Achieved 12% re-leasing spread in Q1; historical spreads of 12-15%
items.quote: We saw 12% re-leasing spreads in this quarter, and so in the past also we've seen 12% to 15% re-leasing spreads when these leases have come up.

items.statement: Market rent growth at high single-digits in deep markets
items.quote: We have seen high single-digit market rent growths in some of our deeper markets, right? And that's perhaps one of the reason why you are starting to already see re-leasing spreads materialize.

items.statement: Industrial rents at ~INR29/sq ft vs warehousing at ~INR24/sq ft (15-20% premium)
items.quote: Today we are sitting on an in-place base rent plus CAM of about INR27.20 per square feet. But if I give you a little bit of guidance and split that, industrial segment in that is almost 20% above the about the standard bare-bone warehousing, which is at about, call it INR24 and industrial buildings today are being leased at a little above INR29.

items.statement: In-city rental guidance of INR70-75/sq ft (2.5-3x big-box parks)
items.quote: INR70, INR75 is a good guidance today, and we will continue to update the market as we gun ahead with the construction and the leasing of these.

items.statement: Operational area of 29.5 million sq ft; target 34-35 million sq ft by end-FY27
items.value: 34 million square feet, 35 million square feet
items.quote: By the time you go towards the end of the fiscal year, our sense is that you will be tracking about a 34 million square feet, 35 million square feet of operational assets.

items.statement: Fully paid land bank for 30 million sq ft of future development
items.quote: Horizon today possesses all the building blocks of a high-growth platform, including a fully-paid land bank, which will deliver 30 million square feet of further development.

items.statement: In-city construction cost ~INR4,500/sq ft (INR500/sq ft above standard industrial)
items.quote: If I give you a direction, this will be at roughly about INR4,500 a foot on construction cost, but rentals, as I said, will be probably 2.5x to 3x more than your big-format parks.

items.statement: Proforma net debt reduced to INR2,500 crores (12.5% of enterprise value) post IPO
items.quote: The proceeds have been deployed for deleveraging, which brings our net debt down to INR2,500 crores, proforma as of end-June or 12.5% of enterprise value.

items.statement: Proforma cash PAT of INR116 crores in Q1 after adjusting for non-cash depreciation and interest savings
items.quote: Adjusting for these, our pro forma cash PAT stands at a healthy INR116 crores.

items.statement: Delhi High Court case challenging tender for 13 in-city warehouses is sub judice; management confident on position
items.quote: That's sub judice, so I will not be able to comment much more on that. But we remain very confident on our position, and we are spearing ahead with our strategy and plan on those assets.

items.statement: Revenue guidance maintained at 15-20% growth for FY27
items.quote: So, we would like to maintain the financial guidance in the similar line what we've given in the last call also, something around 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Three projects expected to add 25-30% incremental revenue at full operationalization
items.quote: And the top level what we can assume is around 25% to 30% incremental in the top line.

items.statement: Total investment of approximately INR500 crores across three strategic initiatives
items.quote: We are pleased to connect with you following the recent announcemen ts regarding three strategic growth initiatives, involving a proposed investment of approximately INR500 crores

items.statement: Ibuprofen expansion capex of INR350 crores with 1.75x asset turn at peak
items.quote: The idea is that this will be commercialized by December 2027. The asset… Abhay Raj Singh: It’s about 1.75x

items.statement: CDMO facility investment of approximately INR110 crores
items.quote: From the CDMO perspective, we are investing approximately INR110 crores right now.

items.statement: Capex to be incurred over FY27 and FY28, 30% already deployed
items.quote: The capex to be incurred across the period of 2 years, that is financial year '27 and financial year '28. As you say and we already disclosed that 30% of capex is already been done.

items.statement: Ibuprofen utilization currently 90-95%, new capacity targeting 25% utilization in FY28 and over 80% optimal
items.quote: And additionally, like our current capacity is exhausted up to the level of 90% to 95%. And third point is we are looking at some of the numbers into our CDMO business also. So, considering all these factors, we are planning to increase the overall capacity of Ibuprofen.

items.statement: CDMO facility expected to reach optimal utilization in 18-24 months
items.quote: We expect the optimal utilization will be achieved in next 18 to 24 months.

items.statement: CDMO business driven by anchor customer requests in Europe with soft commitments in place
items.quote: Because since this business is started on the request from some of our anchor customers. So, again, the development will take place, then regulatory approval process will be there, then we will talk about the commercial quantities.

items.statement: CDMO contracts expected to be 3-5 years with escalation clauses similar to API contracts
items.quote: So, basically, we are in discussions with various customers. This is not the only one customer we can talk about this. So, we are having the idea that contracts will be similar contracts as we have for API, so, these ranges to 3 to 5 years.

items.statement: CDMO formulations will use existing APIs (Ibuprofen, Pantoprazole, Clopidogrel, Metformin) for existing customers
items.quote: So, whatever the product, we are supplying to the existing customers, the customers are existing, products are existing. So, this is the way we have designed

items.statement: Specialty chemical tolling arrangement for new product not currently in portfolio with global chemical company
items.quote: Currently, it is not under our portfolio. So, we have completed the development, and it will be additional to our existing portfolio.

items.statement: Paracetamol prices have softened from peak; Ibuprofen prices stable at elevated levels
items.quote: So the prices of Paracetamol now are not going upward, and most of the chemicals sorry APIs we are in , either stabilized or at least not going upward side. In fact, from the prices of Paracetamol from peak during the last six months, they have softened down.

items.statement: Long-term contracts include price adjustment clauses for raw material fluctuations
items.quote: Yes. And in every contract, we have a clause of price adjustment. And that the price adjustments happen when prices are going down or going up beyond a certain level.

items.statement: Full backward integration for Ibuprofen and Paracetamol controls raw material cost exposure
items.quote: And -- see, because we also have the Ibuprofen facility fully backward integrated , so, in our case, the raw material price fluctuation is up to the maximum extent is controlled by us.

items.statement: Ibuprofen global growth rate 3-4% annually; expansion driven by customer developments and capacity exhaustion
items.quote: And Ibuprofen global growth rate is 3% to 4% every year. That also attract us to expand our Ibu facilities.

items.statement: No knowledge of competitor plant shutdowns driving Ibuprofen demand
items.quote: No, I don't think, or, in fact, we are not having any such information relating to any other plant shutdown in Europe.

items.statement: CDMO entry initiated by European anchor customers requesting finished formulations instead of APIs
items.quote: No, they came back to us that why don't you supply us the bulk tablets instead of sending the APIs? So, probably, this is a both -ways mutual agreement, then we have gone for this arrangement.

items.statement: Specialty chemical tolling arrangement with leading global chemical company providing long-term demand visibility
items.quote: Third, we are also establishing a dedicated specialty chemical facility under a long-term tolling arrangement with a leading global chemical company. This is a customer -led investment, providing visibility of long-term manufacturing demand.

items.statement: All investments funded through internal accruals, no external financing planned
items.quote: Importantly, the proposed investments are planned to be funded through internal accruals in line with our approach towards disciplined capital allocation and our confidence in the company's cash-generation capability.

items.statement: Separate greenfield project of INR1,200-1,400 crores at new site 25-30km away, regulatory approvals in progress
items.quote: And the INR1,200 crores capex is at another site, that is a greenfield project. It's around 25 to 30 kilometers away from the existing site. So, these two are separate.

items.statement: Expected ROCE of around 15% at steady state for all three projects combined
items.quote: As a company as a whole, we are expecting more about 15% ROCE when the -- all the project will be fully implemented.

items.statement: CDMO ramp-up dependent on customer development timelines and regulatory approvals
items.quote: I think as far as the capacity utilization is concerned, we have told you very clearly that there are some customers for which already the development has been started and regulatory approval is IOL Chemicals and also initiated since we got EU -GMP approval also
